name: BEA and BLS information sector data
measures: US information sector real output and employment
about: The Bureau of Economic Analysis publishes real value added by industry, and the Bureau of Labor Statistics publishes employment by industry. We retrieve both through FRED and divide output by workers.
attribution: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, Real Value Added by Industry: Information [RVAI], and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, All Employees, Information [USINFO], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. Not endorsed or certified by BEA.
limitations: The information sector also includes telecoms, publishing, film and broadcasting.
Recent quarters can be revised, and employment here does not count contractors abroad.
